title: Finite-domain geometry and boundary-phase controls
status_detail: HC19 adopted the exact finite-domain scientific design. HC20 selected the broad `ksdft2effmass.solid_state` aggregate, and the same human instruction authorized bounded best-effort implementation without calculation execution. HC21 selected factored dimension-specific lattice-system types plus conventional-cell P/C/I/F/R centering rather than one concrete class per Bravais combination. The initial public implementation now covers one-, two-, and three-dimensional finite integer lattices, boundary twists, scalar hopping and localized-perturbation records, integral operations, DirectLattice/ReciprocalLattice/Lattice compositions, all 1+5+14 Bravais classifications, and caller-toleranced direct--reciprocal duality analysis. Bounded adversarial review reports NO_BLOCKING_FINDINGS_FOR_THE_INITIAL_RECORD_SLICE and retains complex sparse construction and tolerance-dependent Bravais metric classification as explicit next boundaries. Finite-domain campaign implementation, accepted-parent reads, calculation execution, composite work, validation claims, and automatic successor activation remain unauthorized.
